title: FEBCAT Catch Moth Traps 12PCS Moth Killer Moth Repellent for Wardrobes for Ordinary and Other Moths, Suitable for Wardrobe, Closet, And Drawer
bullet_points: 【Working Principle】： The moth traps is a pest that primarily feeds on clothing, fabrics, and other fiber materials. They prefer damp, warm, and undisturbed environments, and therefore often appear in wardrobes, drawers, attics, and storage rooms. By placing the moth killer in these locations, clothes moths can be effectively captured.
【High-Quality Material】： Our moth traps is made from safe materials that do not harm the health of children or pets. It is an ideal solution for addressing clothes moth problems.

【Effective Protection Against Clothes Moths】： Our moth repellent for wardrobes has an irresistible attraction to clothes moths. The adhesive surface provides long-lasting and strong adhesion, ensuring that once clothes moths are captured, they cannot escape.

【Usage Recommendation】： Moth killer are particularly attracted to fabrics containing food residues, such as breadcrumbs, sugar, or starch. It is recommended to place small amounts of these substances on the moth traps to enhance its trapping effectiveness.
【Versatile Uses】： The moth killer is suitable for closets, drawers, shoe cabinets, cars, cabinets, suitcases, pillows, and storage boxes, or it can be hung anywhere at home.
